stockMeaning: Newly modelled finite remaining t0 public clinical and school consumables. Not an observation in the selected 12-commodity source, not OP property, not a purchase, payment, historical delivery or service event.

coverage.rule: minimum + floor((maximum-minimum) * recoveryBps/10000); recovery uses bounded source stockBufferDays, settlementAccess and one-minus max(flood,storm). previousPopulation is never war-casualty evidence.

medicine.dailyBasis: Generated one source-reference-day throughput equivalent per sim day: source dailyMedicalVisitsReference + source hospitalBeds * bedDailyDoseReserve. This is policy calibration, not an observed calendar conversion or historical treatment.

schoolMaterials.dailyBasis: source schoolSeats times unitsPerSeatSimDay; finite student-day material bundle, not a fabricated observation of paper or a new unbounded entitlement.

unchanged: all original inventory entries and provenance
all original financial batches and balances
servicePrerequisites: These stocks alone do not establish service readiness. Actual authorized finite equipment, water, power, staffing and local-currency budget constraints remain separately required. Allocation is prospective, not consumption or stock subtraction.
